pamphlet_excerpts: Groups Breeds Within: The groups, and many of the breeds within these groups, recognized by the AKC are as follows.
Dogs Scent Track: These are dogs that “scent” and either track, point, or flush (reveal a bird’s location and cause it to fly), and retrieve gamebirds on land or in water.
Wide Range Shape: The wide range of shape, size, color, and personality ofpurebred dogs is the result of controlled breeding andselection.
Dogs Bred Hunt: Some dogs were bred to hunt, some to serve asguard or sled dogs, and some to be herders.
step_by_step_procedure: Late Same Time: In the late 1800s, at the same time that dog shows weregaining popularity, a system was developed for classifyingbreeds according to how they are used.
United States American: In the United States, the American Kennel Club has maintained a registry of breedssince 1884.
Recognized Groups Sporting: Recognized groups are sporting dogs, hounds, working dogs, terriers, toys, nonsporting dogs, and herdingdogs.
Within Seven Groups: Within these seven groups, the AKC recognizes 202 breeds (as of 2022, with new breeds being recognized everyyear).

pamphlet_excerpts: Performing Circus Rounding: From performing in the circus to rounding up herds ofsheep, dogs of all ages can be trained to do a variety oftasks.
Dogs Receive Special: Some dogs receive special training to help peoplewho are deaf.
Law Enforcement Agencies: Law enforcement agencies might rely ondogs to find smuggled currency.
Dogs Trainedto Aid: And dogs can be trainedto aid police with the apprehension of criminals.
step_by_step_procedure: Dog Probably Won: Your dog probably won’t learn such complicatedbehaviors as those described above, but your training goalis very important: to help your dog live.
Means Dog Fit: This means that your dog will fit in with you, yourfamily’s activities, and society.
Training Dog House-training: The first step in training your dog is house-training, or gettingyour dog to urinate and defecate outside.
Puppies Generally Bathroom: Puppies generally need to go to the bathroom after theyeat, when they wake up from a nap, and after playing hard.

pamphlet_excerpts: Feeding Canned Food: Feeding canned food to your puppy may be necessary atfirst because of the lack of tooth development.
However Tosoak Dry: However, try tosoak dry food in water to soften it and feed it to your dog assoon as possible.
Canned Foods Flavorful: Canned foods are more flavorful, but they aremostly water.
Pound Pound They: Pound for pound, they do not provide as muchnutrition for a puppy as dry kibble.
step_by_step_procedure: Keepplenty Fresh Dog: Be sure to keepplenty of fresh, When your dog reaches bone growth maturity (whichvaries with each breed), it’s time to switch to an “adultdog” diet.
Adjust Amount Food: Adjust the amount of food you give itbased on its weight and breed.
Reduce Numberof Meals: Reduce the numberof meals from three times a day to two times.
Youcontinue Feed Pet: If youcontinue to feed your pet three meals a day, or keepthe dog food bowl filled during the day, your dogmay become obese.

pamphlet_excerpts: Dog Leash End: After the dog is used to the leash, take up your end of it andwalk around with your pet, applying little or no pressure.
Gradually Short Period: Gradually, over a short period, increase your control until yourdog is completely comfortable being on the leash.
Multiple Short Periods: Multiple, short periods of training are most effective.
Orfive Sessions Day: Four orfive sessions a day, five to 10 minutes each, works well for puppies.
step_by_step_procedure: Older Dogs Tolerate: Older dogs can tolerate sessions of up to 20 minutes long.
American Kennel Club: The American Kennel Club’s Canine Good Citizen® certification programrewards dogs that have good manners at home and in the community.
Theprogram Stresses: Theprogram stresses responsible pet ownership and basic good manners for dogs.
It's Dog Basic: It's important for every dog to know these five basic commands.

pamphlet_excerpts: Probably Dog Sick: You probably will know when your dog is sick because ofchanges in its behavior.
Active Dog Listless: Your active dog might be listless oryour relaxed one restless.
Dog Stop Eating: Your dog might stop eating or start drinking a lotmore water than usual.
Bowel Movements Feces: Bowel movements and feces might become irregular.
step_by_step_procedure: Closer: If you think your dog is sick, take a closer look.
Check Dog Pulse: You can a check a dog’s pulse on theinside of the hind leg, high on the inner thigh near where theleg meets the belly.
Normal Pulse Rates: Normal pulse rates vary among differenttypes of dogs.
Smaller Breeds Toy: Smaller breeds and toy breeds can have heartrates that exceed 120 beats per minute.

pamphlet_excerpts: Dog Healthy Heartwormsociety: Keeping Your Dog Healthy. heartwormsociety.org Heartworm disease can affect dogs in every state.
Dogs Intestinal Parasites: In adult dogs most intestinal parasites are picked up fromthe stool of an infected dog (except tapeworms, which arespread by fleas).
Easily Happen Dogsare: Because this can easily happen when dogsare sniffing around outside, adult dogs should also have a stoolcheck a couple of times a year to screen.
Remember Internal Parasites: Remember, most internal parasites are not visible to the nakedeye, so don’t assume they are not a problem just because youdon’t see them.
step_by_step_procedure: Dogs Heartworms Bite: Dogs can get heartworms through the bite of a mosquitothat carries the parasite.
Dog Infected Longtime: A dog might be infected for a longtime before you know about it because it takes awhile forthe worms to cause damage to the dog’s heart.
Symptoms Ofheartworms: Symptoms ofheartworms could include sluggishness and coughing.
Thesecan Progress Heart: Thesecan progress to heart failure, which can cause death.

pamphlet_excerpts: Origin Dogs Traced: The origin of dogs can be traced to an animal called Miacis, which looked more like a weasel than a dog.
Thissmall Flesh-eating: Thissmall, flesh-eating creature had short legs, a long tail, five toes, and teeth like those of today’s carnivores.
Next Importantancestor: The next importantancestor, called Cynodictis was the first to have doglikecharacteristics, such as a shortened fifth toe, 42 teeth, andlonger legs.
Then Came Descendent: Then came a descendent of Cynodictis, called Tomarctus, which resembled today’s dogs even more.
step_by_step_procedure: Animal Short Erect: This animal had short, erect ears, long legs and tail, and adewclaw that had developed from the shortened fifth toe.
Tomarctus Probably Behaved: Also, Tomarctus probably behaved much like today’s dogs do.

requirements.req_text: Do ONE of the following: (a) Identify three career opportunities that would use skills and knowledge in working with dogs. Pick one and research the training, education, certification requirements, experience, and expenses associated with entering the field. Research the prospects for employment, starting salary, advancement opportunities and career goals associated with this career. Discuss what you learned with your counselor and whether you might be interested in this career. (b) Identify how you might use the skills and knowledge in working with dogs to pursue a personal hobby and/or healthy lifestyle. Research the additional training required, expenses, and affiliation with organizations that would help you maximize the enjoyment and benefit you might gain from it. Discuss what you learned with your counselor and share what short-term and long-term goals you might have if you pursued this.
